sides.text: Which command shows which VLANs are allowed and active on trunks?
A. show interfaces trunk

more.text: show vlan brief does not list trunk ports.

sides.text: What is the default STP priority of a switch?

more.text: Default priority is 32768 plus the VLAN ID in PVST+.

sides.text: Which switch becomes the root bridge?
options: The one with the most ports
The one with the lowest bridge ID

sides.text: C. The one with the lowest bridge ID

more.text: Lowest priority, then lowest MAC.

sides.text: Which protocol is IEEE-standard for EtherChannel negotiation?
D. LACP

more.text: LACP is 802.3ad; PAgP is Cisco.

sides.text: Which LACP mode pair will NOT form a channel?
A. passive and passive

more.text: At least one side must be active.

sides.text: A PC in VLAN 10 cannot reach a PC in VLAN 20 on the same switch with no router. Why?
options: Different VLANs need a Layer 3 device

sides.text: B. Different VLANs need a Layer 3 device

more.text: VLANs are separate broadcast domains.

sides.text: Which feature immediately forwards on edge ports and shuts them down if a BPDU is received when combined with BPDU Guard?
C. PortFast

more.text: PortFast skips listening/learning; BPDU Guard err-disables.

sides.text: Which AP mode lets a lightweight AP forward traffic locally when the WLC is unreachable?
D. FlexConnect

more.text: FlexConnect supports local switching.

sides.text: Which protocol tunnels control and data between a lightweight AP and a WLC?
A. CAPWAP

more.text: CAPWAP replaced LWAPP.

sides.text: A trunk's native VLAN is 99 on one switch and 1 on the other. What is the likely symptom?
options: The trunk becomes an access port

sides.text: B. CDP native VLAN mismatch messages

more.text: Mismatched native VLANs cause logs and untagged traffic leakage.

sides.text: What does CDP use as its default advertisement interval?
C. 60 seconds

more.text: CDP sends every 60 s with a 180 s hold time.

sides.text: Which command enables LLDP globally?
D. lldp run

more.text: Interfaces then transmit and receive.

sides.text: Which port role provides a backup path to the root in RSTP?
A. Alternate

more.text: Alternate ports are blocked paths to the root.

sides.text: What is the default STP path cost of a 1 Gbps link (short method)?

more.text: Short method costs: 10 Mbps 100, 100 Mbps 19, 1 Gbps 4, 10 Gbps 2.

sides.text: Which VLAN range is the normal range?

more.text: Extended range is 1006–4094.

sides.text: Which tag does 802.1Q add to a frame?
D. 4 bytes with a 12-bit VLAN ID

more.text: The tag has TPID, priority, DEI, and a 12-bit VLAN ID.

sides.text: A voice VLAN is configured on an access port. What is it used for?
options: IP phone traffic tagged separately from the PC

sides.text: A. IP phone traffic tagged separately from the PC

more.text: The phone tags voice; the PC stays untagged.

sides.text: Which WLC QoS profile is intended for voice?
B. Platinum

more.text: Platinum voice, Gold video, Silver best effort, Bronze background.

sides.text: Which management access method sends credentials in clear text?
C. Telnet

more.text: Telnet is unencrypted.

sides.text: Which protocol authorizes individual commands and encrypts the full payload?
D. TACACS+

more.text: TACACS+ separates AAA over TCP 49.

sides.text: How many links can be active in one EtherChannel bundle?
A. Up to 8

more.text: Eight active links (and eight standby in LACP).

sides.text: An AP connected to a switch in local mode normally uses which port type?
B. Access port

more.text: FlexConnect with multiple VLANs may need a trunk.

sides.text: Which STP feature blocks a port that receives superior BPDUs?
C. Root Guard

more.text: It keeps the root bridge where designed.

sides.text: A WLAN must use a passphrase with AES. In the WLC GUI, where is this set?
options: WLAN Security tab: WPA2 with PSK

sides.text: D. WLAN Security tab: WPA2 with PSK

more.text: Layer 2 security options live on the Security tab.

sides.text: Which command shows the MAC addresses a switch learned?
A. show mac address-table dynamic

more.text: The MAC table maps addresses to ports.
